title.en: Unit 5 Notes — Chemical Admixture, Special Concrete and Modern Trends

items.syllabus_item: 5.1 accelerators, retarders, water reducers, air entrainers, superplasticizers

body.en:
Admixtures are materials other than cement, aggregate and water added before or during mixing to modify concrete performance. Accelerators speed setting or early strength; avoid chloride-based products in reinforced or prestressed work where prohibited. Retarders delay setting for hot weather or long transport but can over-retard if overdosed. Water reducers achieve required workability with less water; superplasticizers provide high-range water reduction or greater flow at controlled water content. Air-entraining agents deliberately create small stable bubbles to improve freeze–thaw resistance where needed, often reducing strength and changing water demand.

Confirm dosage basis, cement compatibility, sequence, slump retention, setting, strength, air and durability with trials; use current IS 9103 and applicable project requirements. Chemical admixtures are not a licence to disregard mix design, curing or quality control.
body.gu:
Admixtures એ cement, aggregate અને water સિવાય mixing પહેલાં કે દરમિયાન ઉમેરાતા materials છે જે concrete નું performance બદલે છે. Accelerators setting અથવા early strength ઝડપી કરે; જ્યાં પ્રતિબંધ હોય ત્યાં reinforced/prestressed work માં chloride-based products ન વાપરો. Retarders ગરમી કે લાંબા transport માં setting મોડું કરે, પણ overdose થી અતિશય વિલંબ થઈ શકે. Water reducers ઓછી water સાથે જરૂરી workability આપે; superplasticizers controlled water પર વધારે flow અથવા high-range water reduction આપે. Air-entraining agents નાના સ્થિર bubbles બનાવી જરૂરી હોય ત્યાં freeze–thaw resistance વધારે છે, પરંતુ strength ઘટાડી અને water demand બદલી શકે છે.

Dosage basis, cement compatibility, sequence, slump retention, setting, strength, air અને durability trial થી તપાસો; current IS 9103 અને project requirements અનુસરો. Admixture હોવા છતાં mix design, curing અને quality control જરૂરી છે.

items.syllabus_item: 5.2 SCC and pervious concrete: properties advantages limitations

body.en:
Self-compacting concrete (SCC) flows under its own weight, passes reinforcement and fills formwork without conventional vibration while resisting segregation. It suits congested reinforcement and complex forms; check filling ability, passing ability and stability using appropriate tests. It requires careful proportioning, compatible admixture, close moisture control and leak-tight formwork; excessive fluidity without stability can segregate.

Pervious concrete contains a connected void structure to pass water and reduce runoff when placed over a suitable permeable sub-base. It normally has little fine aggregate, requires controlled water and compaction, and generally has lower strength than dense structural concrete. Clogging, freeze–thaw exposure, subgrade permeability and groundwater protection govern design and maintenance; infiltration does not mean unfiltered water can safely be discharged anywhere.
body.gu:
Self-compacting concrete (SCC) પોતાના વજનથી વહે છે, reinforcement માંથી પસાર થાય છે અને સામાન્ય vibration વગર form ભરે છે, સાથે segregation સામે પ્રતિકાર કરે છે. Congested reinforcement અને જટિલ forms માટે ઉપયોગી છે; યોગ્ય tests થી filling ability, passing ability અને stability તપાસો. કાળજીપૂર્વક proportioning, compatible admixture, moisture control અને leak-tight formwork જરૂરી છે; stability વગર વધુ fluidity થી segregation થઈ શકે.

Pervious concrete માં જોડાયેલા voids થી પાણી પસાર થાય છે અને યોગ્ય permeable sub-base ઉપર runoff ઘટે છે. સામાન્ય રીતે fine aggregate ઓછું હોય છે; water અને compaction નિયંત્રિત કરવાં પડે છે અને dense structural concrete કરતાં strength સામાન્ય રીતે ઓછી હોય છે. Clogging, freeze–thaw exposure, subgrade permeability અને groundwater protection પ્રમાણે design તથા maintenance કરો; infiltration નો અર્થ ક્યાંય પણ અશુદ્ધ water છોડવું સલામત છે એવો નથી.

items.syllabus_item: 5.2 fiber reinforced concrete and ready mix concrete

body.en:
Fibre reinforced concrete (FRC) contains dispersed steel, synthetic, glass or other fibres selected for the application. Fibres can bridge cracks and improve post-cracking toughness, impact resistance or plastic-shrinkage crack control; their effect depends on type, dosage, distribution and anchorage. Fibres do not automatically replace structural reinforcement without a specific design. Poor dispersion can cause balling and reduce workability.

Ready-mix concrete (RMC) is produced in a batching plant and delivered in transit mixers or other approved vehicles. It offers controlled batching and efficient delivery, but needs reliable dispatch, travel-time control, site access and acceptance testing. Prohibit unapproved water addition on arrival; record delivery time, grade, slump and batch data.
body.gu:
Fibre reinforced concrete (FRC) માં ઉપયોગ પ્રમાણે steel, synthetic, glass અથવા અન્ય fibres મિશ્રિત હોય છે. Fibres cracks ને bridge કરી post-cracking toughness, impact resistance અથવા plastic-shrinkage crack control સુધારી શકે છે; અસર type, dosage, distribution અને anchorage પર આધારિત છે. ચોક્કસ design વગર fibres આપોઆપ structural reinforcement નો વિકલ્પ નથી. ખરાબ dispersion થી balling અને ઓછી workability થાય છે.

Ready-mix concrete (RMC) batching plant માં બનાવી transit mixer અથવા અન્ય approved vehicle થી પહોંચાડાય છે. Controlled batching અને કાર્યક્ષમ delivery મળે છે, પરંતુ dispatch, travel time, site access અને acceptance tests જરૂરી છે. પહોંચ્યા પછી મંજૂરી વગર water ન ઉમેરો; delivery time, grade, slump અને batch data નોંધો.

h.en: 5.4 Fly ash and recycled aggregate concrete
h.gu: 5.4 Fly ash અને recycled aggregate concrete

items.syllabus_item: 5.2 fly ash concrete and recycled aggregate concrete

body.en:
Fly ash concrete uses a suitable tested fly ash as part of the binder. Its pozzolanic reaction may reduce heat and improve later-age durability under appropriate curing; early strength can be slower, especially in cold conditions. Replacement level, ash quality, cement compatibility and exposure govern performance. Do not assume all fly ash has identical composition.

Recycled aggregate concrete uses processed aggregate from demolished concrete where permitted. It can conserve natural aggregate and reduce waste; attached old mortar often increases absorption and variability. Verify contamination, grading, strength, moisture and permitted replacement level under applicable current standards. Trial mixes and moisture correction are essential; recycling does not automatically guarantee lower total environmental impact.
body.gu:
Fly ash concrete માં યોગ્ય tested fly ash binder ના ભાગરૂપે વપરાય છે. યોગ્ય curing હેઠળ તેની pozzolanic reaction heat ઘટાડી later-age durability સુધારી શકે; ખાસ કરીને ઠંડીમાં early strength ધીમી હોઈ શકે છે. Replacement level, ash quality, cement compatibility અને exposure performance નક્કી કરે છે. બધી fly ash ની composition સરખી માનવી નહીં.

Recycled aggregate concrete માં મંજૂરી મુજબ તોડેલા concrete માંથી process કરેલ aggregate વપરાય છે. Natural aggregate અને waste ઘટાડી શકાય; જૂના જોડાયેલા mortar થી absorption અને variability વધી શકે. Contamination, grading, strength, moisture તથા મંજૂર replacement level હાલના standards મુજબ તપાસો. Trial mixes અને moisture correction જરૂરી છે; recycling થી કુલ environmental impact આપોઆપ ઓછો થાય એવું નહીં.

items.syllabus_item: 5.2 high performance concrete and 3D printed concrete

body.en:
High-performance concrete (HPC) is designed for demanding specified performance such as low permeability, strength, workability or service life; high strength alone does not define every performance requirement. Low water–binder ratio, supplementary cementitious materials and high-range water reducer may be used, with careful quality control and curing. Cost, early-age cracking and material compatibility are possible constraints.

3D-printed concrete is deposited layer by layer by controlled extrusion or another automated process. It can reduce formwork and enable complex shapes, but requires pumpability, extrudability, buildability and interlayer bond. Time between layers, reinforcement integration, anisotropy, curing, dimensional control and fire/durability assessment require an engineered, approved procedure; printed material is not automatically suitable for every structural application.
body.gu:
High-performance concrete (HPC) નિર્ધારિત કઠિન performance જેમ કે ઓછી permeability, strength, workability અથવા service life માટે design થાય છે; માત્ર high strength થી દરેક performance requirement નક્કી થતી નથી. Low water–binder ratio, supplementary cementitious materials અને high-range water reducer ઉપયોગી હોઈ શકે, સાથે કાળજીપૂર્વક quality control અને curing જરૂરી છે. Cost, early-age cracking અને compatibility મર્યાદાઓ હોઈ શકે છે.

3D-printed concrete નિયંત્રિત extrusion અથવા અન્ય automation થી layer by layer મૂકાય છે. Formwork ઓછું કરી જટિલ આકાર બનાવી શકાય, પરંતુ pumpability, extrudability, buildability અને interlayer bond જરૂરી છે. Layers વચ્ચેનો સમય, reinforcement integration, anisotropy, curing, dimensional control અને fire/durability માટે engineered તથા approved procedure જરૂરી છે; દરેક structural application માટે તે આપોઆપ યોગ્ય નથી.

h.en: 5.6 Modern trends, research and responsible selection
h.gu: 5.6 Modern trends, research અને જવાબદાર પસંદગી

items.syllabus_item: 5.3 modern trends and research, relevant journals and institutes

body.en: Current research explores lower-clinker binders, supplementary materials, carbon capture or mineralisation, recycled materials, digital quality control, self-healing systems and performance-based durability design. Compare options using verified mechanical, durability, safety and life-cycle evidence; a research concept is not automatically an approved site method. Relevant Indian institutions include CSIR–CBRI, IITs, NCB (National Council for Cement and Building Materials) and BIS. Peer-reviewed examples include Cement and Concrete Research and Construction and Building Materials; check methods, material provenance and publication date before applying results.
body.gu: આધુનિક research માં lower-clinker binders, supplementary materials, carbon capture/mineralisation, recycled materials, digital quality control, self-healing systems અને performance-based durability design સામેલ છે. વિકલ્પોની સરખામણી ચકાસેલ mechanical, durability, safety અને life-cycle evidence પરથી કરો; research concept આપોઆપ site માટે approved method નથી. ભારતીય સંસ્થાઓમાં CSIR–CBRI, IITs, NCB (National Council for Cement and Building Materials) અને BIS છે. Peer-reviewed journals માં Cement and Concrete Research અને Construction and Building Materials ઉદાહરણ છે; પરિણામ લાગુ કરતાં method, materials અને publication date તપાસો.

body.en:
Given: A batch contains 400 kg binder. Liquid admixture dosage is 0.8% of binder mass. Find admixture mass.

Step 1. Convert percentage to decimal.

Dosage fraction = 0.8 / 100Dosage fraction = 0.008

Step 2. Multiply by binder mass.

Admixture = 400 × 0.008

Final answer:

Admixture = 3.2 kg
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Batch માં 400 kg binder છે. Liquid admixture dosage binder mass ના 0.8% છે. Admixture mass શોધો.

Step 1. Percentage ને decimal માં ફેરવો.

Dosage fraction = 0.8 / 100Dosage fraction = 0.008

Step 2. Binder mass થી ગુણો.

Admixture = 400 × 0.008

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Admixture = 3.2 kg

body.en:
Given: A trial needs 190 kg water without admixture. A verified admixture reduces water by 15% at the same workability. Find new water content.

Step 1. Calculate water saved.

Water saved = 190 × 0.15Water saved = 28.5 kg

Step 2. Subtract saved water.

New water = 190 − 28.5

Final answer:

New water = 161.5 kg
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Admixture વગર trial માં 190 kg water જોઈએ છે. ચકાસેલ admixture સમાન workability પર water 15% ઘટાડે છે. નવું water content શોધો.

Step 1. બચેલ water ગણો.

Water saved = 190 × 0.15Water saved = 28.5 kg

Step 2. બચેલ water બાદ કરો.

New water = 190 − 28.5

અંતિમ જવાબ:

નવું water = 161.5 kg

title.en: Numerical 5.3 — Fly ash replacement by mass
title.gu: Numerical 5.3 — Mass પ્રમાણે fly ash replacement

body.en:
Given: Total binder is 400 kg/m³. Fly ash is 25% of binder mass. Find fly ash and cement quantities.

Step 1. Find fly ash mass.

Fly ash = 400 × 0.25Fly ash = 100 kg/m³

Step 2. Find remaining cement mass.

Cement = 400 − 100

Final answer:

Fly ash = 100 kg/m³; cement = 300 kg/m³
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: કુલ binder 400 kg/m³ છે. Fly ash binder mass ના 25% છે. Fly ash અને cement ગણો.

Step 1. Fly ash mass શોધો.

Fly ash = 400 × 0.25Fly ash = 100 kg/m³

Step 2. બાકી cement mass શોધો.

Cement = 400 − 100

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Fly ash = 100 kg/m³; cement = 300 kg/m³

title.en: Formulae, methods and key data — Unit 5
title.gu: Formulae, methods અને key data — યુનિટ 5

body.en:
Use the specified dosage basis and verify compatibility by trials.

Admixture mass = binder mass × dosage fractionReduced water = original water × (1 − verified reduction fraction)Fly ash mass = total binder mass × replacement fraction
body.gu:
નિર્ધારિત dosage basis વાપરો અને trials થી compatibility ચકાસો.

Admixture mass = binder mass × dosage fractionReduced water = original water × (1 − verified reduction fraction)Fly ash mass = total binder mass × replacement fraction
